headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.17
summary: The About screen now gives credit where it is due: a live Contributors list with avatars and commit counts sits right below the authors, fetched straight from GitHub.

items.text: New Contributors card in the About screen, right below Authors & Maintainers: every repository contributor shows up with their avatar and commit count, and tapping a row opens their GitHub profile. The card hides itself when the list cannot be fetched, and avatars are decoded with downsampling to stay light on low-RAM devices.
